details.description: gte-base (General Text Embeddings, base) is a BERT-based English embedding model from Alibaba's DAMO Academy, trained with multi-stage contrastive learning on large-scale relevance text pairs. It maps text to 768-dimensional embeddings with a 512-token input limit and is built for retrieval, semantic similarity and reranking tasks. Alibaba-NLP has since released gte-base-en-v1.5, an upgraded model in the same family with an 8,192-token context length and a higher MTEB score, making the original gte-base an earlier-generation model.
advantages: Scores 62.39 average across 56 tasks on the MTEB benchmark, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 84.57 on MTEB Pair Classification and 82.3 on MTEB Semantic Textual Similarity, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 73.01 on MTEB Classification and 58.61 on MTEB Reranking, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Compact 0.22GB model size compared to the larger gte-large model in the same family, per the model's Hugging Face card.
disadvantages: 512-token maximum input length; the model card states longer text is truncated to this limit.
English only; the model card states it 'exclusively caters to English texts.'
Superseded by Alibaba-NLP's gte-base-en-v1.5, which extends the context length to 8,192 tokens and scores 64.11 on MTEB, per that model's Hugging Face card.
Lower MTEB Clustering (46.2) and Summarization (31.17) scores than its other MTEB task categories, per the model's Hugging Face card.
use_cases: General-purpose English text classification and clustering

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (512) matches the model's Hugging Face card exactly. Noted the newer gte-base-en-v1.5 as a supersession/limitation, but wrote up gte-base itself since that is the model in the catalog's uris. No GitHub repo was confirmed specifically for this model, so github_url is null.
